highlights.title: Diagrams and files, right in Chat
highlights.line: Flowcharts draw themselves, and every file an agent names opens with a tap.

highlights.title: Back in seconds after switching networks
highlights.line: Wi-Fi to mobile data and back: Mewla reconnects as soon as the network does.

highlights.title: Every update, told in Chat
highlights.line: A line in Brain's chat marks each update. Tap it to see what's new.

fixes: A Brain thread's chat opens on its own messages, at its end or where you were reading.
Windows: mewla update restarts a Mewla installed over SSH.
iPhone and iPad keyboards: Alt+b and Alt+f jump by word in the terminal.
